actions.name: __adhoc_http_action

actions.name: copy_file
actions.title: Copy file or folder
actions.description: Copy file or folder in Dropbox
actions.help: Copy a file or folder to a different location in the user's Dropbox. If the source path is a folder all its contents will be copied. Please provide the full path of the file or folder for both source and destination

input.name: account_type
input.label: Account type
input.hint: Default account type is set to Personal .

input.name: from_path
input.label: From path
input.hint: Full path (incl. parent folders) of file/folder to copy. Eg: /folder_1/file_name.doc

input.hint: Full path (incl. parent folders) of destination name. Eg: /folder_2/file_name.doc

input.name: autorename
input.label: Auto rename
input.hint: If there's a conflict, have the Dropbox server try to autorename the file to avoid the conflict. The default for this field is False .

input.name: account_type
